checkpoint_selection: lowest equal-weight average of prompted and unprompted development anatomy loss (batch means), never test loss
normalization: observed-point median only; fixed 500mm, RAS source axes
primary_test: common two-reference CT-source images; reference noise 0mm; endpoints T3/L2 omitted from all method scores
aggregation: mean over valid nonreference levels -> median over three seeds per CT image -> image-equal median/mean
test_candidate_surface: same cached8192 CT skin points for all methods, not predicted MHR
geometry_evaluation: fixed disjoint observed/query indices, simulated query displacement; not clinical sensor accuracy
